Sandbox_BusStop_UseItemPayment_tooltip: When enabled, fares are deducted from the player's inventory (Currency Item). If both Pay with Items and Pay with Bank are active, items are deducted first.
Sandbox_BusStop_UseBankPayment_tooltip: When enabled, fares are deducted from a bank mod's balance via its API (requires Bank Mod Global). If both sources are active, the bank covers any amount that items could not cover.
Sandbox_BusStop_BankModGlobal_tooltip: Name of the Lua global the bank mod exposes its API under (e.g. MyBankMod). Must have a .API table with canAfford, deduct, formatLabel. Only used when Pay with Bank is enabled.
Sandbox_BusStop_CurrencyItem_tooltip: Item type used as bus fare currency (e.g. Base.Money). Only used when Pay with Items is enabled.
Sandbox_BusStop_BasePrice_tooltip: Base cost in currency items for any trip, regardless of distance.
Sandbox_BusStop_PricePerTile_tooltip: Extra cost per tile of distance for dynamic pricing. Value is multiplied by 0.001 — default 1 means 0.001 per tile.
Sandbox_BusStop_EnableRandomTrip_tooltip: When enabled, a Random Trip button appears in the travel panel. The destination is chosen randomly by the server from all available stops.
Sandbox_BusStop_RandomTripPrice_tooltip: Flat fare charged when a player uses the Random Trip button. Set to 0 for free random trips.
Sandbox_BusStop_ReturnTripHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours a return ticket remains valid after traveling to a destination. These are in-game hours, not real time — they advance based on the server's time speed multiplier. Default is 24 in-game hours.
Sandbox_BusStop_EnableTicketItem_tooltip: When enabled, holding a Bus Ticket Item pays for a trip for free (consuming one) at any stop that accepts it. When disabled, the item has no effect even if a player holds one.
Sandbox_BusStop_TicketItem_tooltip: Item type that acts as a free bus fare (e.g. BusStop.BusTicket). Only used when Enable Bus Ticket Item is on.
Sandbox_BusStop_SpawnTicketInBuildings_t: When enabled, the Ticket Item is added to building loot distributions (schools, offices, houses) so it can be found while exploring.
Sandbox_BusStop_TicketBuildingSpawnRate_: Relative chance weight used when adding the Ticket Item to building loot containers. Higher = more common. Only used when Spawn Ticket in Buildings is on.
Sandbox_BusStop_SpawnTicketOnZombies_too: When enabled, the Ticket Item is added to zombie corpse loot (any zombie, plus a few commuter-type outfits) so it can be found by looting zombies.
Sandbox_BusStop_TicketZombieSpawnRate_to: Relative chance weight used when adding the Ticket Item to zombie corpse loot. Higher = more common. Only used when Spawn Ticket on Zombies is on.
Sandbox_BusStop_ShowDisabledStopsAsTrans: When disabled (default), a disabled stop's map/minimap marker still shows in full color, same as an active stop. When enabled, disabled stops show faded/transparent instead.
